page.overview:
Who is Sadus?

Sadus was a mysterious Fremen who instructed the Prisoner in the Trials of Aql.

Sadus first appeared to the Prisoner when they entered the first Trial of Aql in Mihna Cavern. As the Prisoner avoided being seen by the observing eyes, she told them of the hardships the Fremen had endured on Harmonthep, where they were forbidden to take part in the Hajj and their children were taken from them and made into slaves. Once they completed the trial, she advised them to remember the suffering of the Fremen.
